versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkTriggerTransmit callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkTriggerTransmit callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTrigger- Transmit API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTrigger- Transmit call is returned unchanged from the Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTrigger- Transmit API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTrigger- Transmit call is returned unchanged from the Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback.
